name: golos_casts_an_exiled_instant_on_an_opponents_turn_seen_by_brineborn_cutthroat
notes: Printed: '{2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play them this turn without paying their mana costs.' On the opponent's turn Golos's ability (an activated ability, any time you have priority) exiles Shock, a Mountain and Leafkin Druid; Shock is cast from exile for nothing at the opponent (18). A spell cast during an opponent's turn: Brineborn Cutthroat gets a +1/+1 counter. The Mountain cannot be played on the opponent's turn (CR 305.1).
